name: Dense Research Report
tagline: White page with a blue hairline header, bold sans headline claims, a grid of small bar charts and mono KPI tiles in electric blue and cool grey (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: White page, near-black text, one electric blue for emphasis and highlighted bars, cool grey for context data.

typography.style: Heavy sans headline stating the finding, small sans chart labels and Geist Mono for KPI numbers.

best_for: Report-style slides that carry several charts, a table or a KPI block at once, where the headline is the conclusion. Good for analysts presenting trends to informed readers.
avoid_for: Keynotes with one idea per slide or audiences far from the screen.
